title: Isomorphic Labs
summary: London company applying AlphaFold-era models to drug discovery, spun out of DeepMind.
bodyHtml:
Isomorphic Labs is building a drug-discovery engine on top of protein-structure prediction and generative chemistry, with partnerships with Eli Lilly and Novartis.

The company aims to predict how a molecule will bind and behave before it is synthesised, shortening the discovery phase.

Why it matters

  • Structure prediction
  • Generative chemistry
  • Large pharma partnerships

businessMeaning: If binding prediction becomes reliable, the cost of finding a starting molecule falls sharply. The remaining risk is clinical failure, not discovery.
investmentLens: Private inside Alphabet; the read is through pharma partners and the AI compute supply chain.
